review_samples.author: Cami Richardson
review_samples.text: I highly recommend Nick! We had a bee infestation under our shed and he and Jimmy came out the very next day and removed it for us. They were the best! Also removed a small snake for us that showed up while they were here. Use them for your critter removals! They're the best! Thank you Nick & Jimmy!

review_samples.author: Nancy Mitchell
review_samples.text: Excellent service at a reasonable cost. We had a significant problem with an iguana infestation. Maynard's went above and beyond to make sure our problem was addressed. They were knowledgeable about how to address the problem.

review_samples.author: Tammy Storms
review_samples.text: Twice I had to utilize pest removal for animals in my attic. The first company had 0 results for a weeks worth of service. Second go round I used Maynard's. Nick and Jim were amazing. Results the first night.

review_samples.author: theuniqueandantique
review_samples.text: Nick is amazing! While having a 40' palm trimmed we realized there was a large honeybee nest 30' off the ground in the trunk. I worried I wouldn't be able to find anyone who could relocate the bees.

photos_source: Google Maps photo viewer (gmaps_photocycle.js), 11 photos pulled, 1 exact duplicate removed. Of the 10 unique photos, 1 (extreme close-up of a hissing opossum mouth) was excluded from the site on visual-curation grounds (too graphic/intense for a premium gallery); the remaining 9 were reviewed and used across hero/about/gallery.
